CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.description: Displays the full name of the internal user, the external attendee name (if not a broker), or the external contact’s name, based on the attendee type and subtype.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType , 'Internal'), User.FirstName & " " & User.LastName , IF(AND (ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType , 'External'), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Attendee_SubType__c , 'Broker'))), Attendee_Name__c, IF(ISPICKVAL( AttendeeType , 'External'), Contact.FirstName & " " & Contact.LastName, '') ) )
CustomField.label: Attendee Name
